text: じぶんの　ポケモンを　くわしく　しることも　たいせつじゃ！

structure.jp: じぶんの　ポケモンを　くわしく　しることも
structure.en: knowing your Pokémon in detail, too

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと turns a verb into a thing, like 'doing'. しること = 'knowing'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is an old-man way of saying だ. たいせつじゃ = 'it is important'.
